name: the ledger under a constitution -- sentence-level cases for Haro v0.23 (ZC2)
comment: Written BEFORE the court code (the W discipline). Each case runs the court forged from ledger_v23.haro on rnxc AND on the oracle; the two must print the same bytes. 'first' is a fragment of the first output line; 'contains' fragments of the whole output; 'record' is the C2 record on the second line of a refine refusal; 'diagnose' is the first diagnostic of a diagnose run. The articles' numbers are Zin's (constitution.zig:35-40).

cases.name: the clean ledger is a sentence: two accounts, one limit
the meta-court reads the ledger's declaration under its four articles
Art. 1 through RATIONALE: a declaration without one is refused, and the refusal names the article
contains: RATIONALE is mandatory on every declaration (LIMIT daily_cash has none)

cases.name: Art. 1 through the C2 envelope: the same refusal diagnosed carries the code RATIONALE and cites article:1
Art. 1 through the NARRATE: the refusal told in the ledger's voice names its line, its code and its cite
a maker's own CONSTRAINT refuses under its CODE and cites what it CITES (CITES on CONSTRAINT, built here)
Art. 6 through the trust posture: a model-composed proposal below a knob's floor is refused, the article named, the record citing it
cases.first: trust: posture :llm below the required floor :external for 'main.CEILING' [Art. 6 trust_hierarchy]

cases.name: Art. 6: a policy point floored trusted refuses an external actor too -- the floor is the point's
cases.first: trust: posture :external below the required floor :trusted for 'daily_cash.RULE' [Art. 6 trust_hierarchy]

cases.name: Art. 2 through refinement: the external actor's proposal at the floor is admitted, and the inverse written before it landed restores the ledger byte for byte
the floor is per point: a field floored llm admits a model's words
